items.example: I got your message this morning.
items.simple: Words you send to a person on a phone.

items.example: Sorry, I forgot to reply.
items.simple: You send words back to a person.

items.example: I'm busy now. I'll text you later.
items.exampleTr: Şimdi meşgulüm. Sana sonra mesaj atarım.
items.simple: I will send you words on my phone later.

items.example: My battery is almost dead.
items.simple: The thing in your phone that gives it power.

items.en: My phone is about to die.
items.example: My phone is about to die. Do you have a charger?
items.exampleTr: Telefonumun şarjı bitmek üzere. Şarj aletin var mı?
items.simple: My phone will stop soon because it has no power.

items.example: I need to charge my phone.
items.simple: You put power into your phone so it can work.

items.example: There’s no signal in the lift.
items.simple: The thing that lets your phone talk to others.

items.example: Sorry, I've got no signal here.
items.simple: My phone cannot talk to others here.

items.example: I forgot my password again.
items.simple: A secret word only you know, so no one else can come in.

items.example: Can you download the file?
items.simple: You take a thing from the internet and keep it on your phone.

items.example: I use this app every day.
items.simple: A small game or tool on your phone.

items.example: I turned off all notifications.
items.simple: A small sound or picture that says something new came.

items.example: I deleted the photo by mistake.
items.simple: You take it away, so it is gone.

items.example: My phone needs to update.
items.simple: You make it new, so it works better.

items.example: Can you send me the link?
items.simple: A word you touch to go to another place on the phone.

items.example: Sorry, I missed your call.
items.simple: You say this when someone called or wrote to you, and you did not see or hear it.

items.example: I’ll call you back in ten minutes.
items.exampleTr: On dakika sonra seni geri ararım.
items.simple: Someone called you before. Now you call them on the phone.

items.example: He hung up before I could answer.
items.simple: You stop talking on the phone.

items.example: I can’t log in to my account.
items.simple: You use your secret word to go in.

items.example: Hold on a second. I’ll get my laptop.
items.simple: Please wait a little bit.
items.note: Telefonda "Bir dakika, hattan ayrılmayın" gibi de kullanılır.

items.example: Sorry, the line is bad. Can you repeat that?
items.exampleTr: Üzgünüm, hat kötü. Tekrar eder misin?
items.simple: I cannot hear you well on the phone.

items.example: I broke my phone screen.
items.simple: The flat part of your phone that you look at.
